artifact.name: Z-Girl — Public Demo Access & Metered AI Lock

review.evaluator: Greene Media Studio governed production review
review.notes: Second narrow demo-security hardening requested within the owner-approved public demo conversion: in addition to live supporter-data routes, anonymous public access to metered AI coach/chat/voice endpoints is blocked to prevent unauthorized usage and cost. Broader v3.18 visual/commercial release remains locked.

ai_uses.purpose: Preserve Z-Girl public discovery while preventing anonymous use of live-data and metered generative AI capabilities
ai_uses.user_or_production_value: Visitors can explore non-metered demo surfaces while real supporter persistence and paid AI generation require a future approved access path
ai_uses.human_oversight: Existing institutional and credential operator authorization remains unchanged; participant sharing remains human-controlled; broader commercial launch remains owner-governed
ai_uses.provenance: Z-Girl governed application repository lgreene2/zgirl-hero-coach; central 4L Premium + AI Impact gate

automation.no_additional_automation_rationale: Public demo blocking is automated. Authorized customer access to metered AI and live supporter-sharing will require a separate server-validated entitlement/session architecture rather than a client-controlled bypass.

evidence: Blocked live and metered capabilities route to the purpose-built Z-Girl Demo access experience
Metered AI remains a governed product capability rather than an anonymously consumable public endpoint
Prevents unauthorized AI spend and live-data use while preserving safe public product discovery
Middleware blocks supporter handoff routes plus /coach, /api/chat, /api/zgirl, and /api/voice in public demo mode
No client-controlled authorization bypass is present
Demo boundary remains responsive, text-first, and keyboard-navigable
No character canon, lesson content, or third-party visual asset is changed
Live supporter data and metered AI are unavailable to anonymous public users
Existing credential/institution operator authentication remains untouched
Broader release authority is not granted

exceptions: Owner approval applies only to the public demo/security hardening requested in the current production session. It does not approve PR #48, unresolved human-visual rights, paid commercial launch, affiliate/reseller terms, fundraising claims, institutional activation, or the future customer entitlement architecture.
